title: SAPSNC: Added SAP SNC as main dissector
description:
Added the SAP SNC dissector protocol from [SecureAuth's plugin](https://github.com/SecureAuthCorp/SAP-Dissection-plug-in-for-Wireshark/blob/master/src/packet-sapsnc.c).

This is a basic dissector for the SAP Secure Network Connection protocol. It dissects the basic SNC frame fields, and if the QoP (quality of protection) is only set to wrap/seal but not encrypt, it can be used to extract the content and further dissect it on an upper layer.

Some details and example requests can be found in pysap's documentation: https://pysap.readthedocs.io/en/latest/protocols/SAPSNC.html.

+extern /**
